items.name: Trade Republic
items.etfSparplaeneCaveat: Provider states 2,500+ or 2,827 savings plans depending on the source — the number varies slightly
items.intervalleText: 6 intervals: weekly, every 2 weeks, monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, annually
items.guthabenzinsCaveat: Provider states either 2.25% or 2.50% p.a. depending on the source — the more recent, more commonly cited figure is shown here
items.verwahrentgeltText: No ongoing custody fee (possibly except for Xetra-Gold, ADRs/GDRs — amount not disclosed by the provider)

items.name: Scalable Capital
items.intervalleText: 5 execution intervals, 9 selectable execution days (exact names not broken down by the provider)
items.guthabenzinsLimitText: unlimited amount (Free Broker: deposit protection up to €100,000; PRIME+: multiple deposit protection up to €500,000)
items.verwahrentgeltText: No custody fee, account maintenance is free in principle

items.name: Consorsbank
items.etfSparplaeneCaveat: Over 2,000 free ETF savings plans out of more than 8,000 eligible securities overall
items.intervalleText: Execution intervals not broken down in detail by the provider
items.guthabenzinsCaveat: Interest on the cash account is not disclosed — the provider only advertises limited-time savings promotions for new customers (e.g. 3.8–4.0% for 5–6 months)
items.verwahrentgeltText: No ongoing fees as long as securities are held in standard collective custody

items.name: comdirect
items.depotgebuehrText: €23.40/year, waived with a comdirect current account, an active savings plan, or ≥ 2 trades/quarter
items.etfSparplaeneCaveat: Around 550–600 of these can be saved into fee-free — the exact figure varies by source (some cite up to 2,700 savings plans in total)
items.intervalleText: 5 intervals: monthly, every 2 months, quarterly, semi-annually, annually
items.guthabenzinsLimitText: on the Tagesgeld PLUS account, up to €250,000
items.verwahrentgeltText: No separate custody fee beyond the account fee

items.name: flatex
items.etfSparplaeneCaveat: The number of fee-free ETFs among these 1,821 savings plans is not disclosed by the provider
items.intervalleText: 4 execution intervals, 2 execution days (exact names not broken down by the provider)
items.guthabenzinsCaveat: Interest on the cash account is not disclosed by the provider
items.verwahrentgeltText: No general custody fee (possibly except for Xetra-Gold, ADRs/GDRs — amount not disclosed)
